text.title: Evolutionary Architecture Fitness Functions — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the architectural characteristics the team cares about to a committed fitness-function suite spec running in CI with a trended results series: name characteristics, write the dependency graph and structural function, pick a tool and command per function, measure baselines, set thresholds in absolute or ratchet mode, classify blocking/triggered, wire the results store, assign owners and the review.

step.name: name-characteristics
step.input: Architecture decision records, the last two incident reviews, the quality attributes the architecture claims to protect.
step.action: List every characteristic worth guarding as one noun phrase with a metric and unit ("afferent coupling of billing.core, count"; "p95 latency of POST /checkout at 200 rps, ms"). Strike every entry that is an -ility with no metric.
step.decision-gate: An entry that cannot be given a metric and unit is deleted, not kept as a manual review item (r-ff-one-attribute-one-metric).

step.name: write-dependency-graph
step.input: The intended layering or module boundaries (C4 container/component view, package layout).
step.action: Write `dependency_graph.layers[]` and `dependency_graph.allowed_edges[]` in the spec, then add the structural function (`kind: structural`) that enforces it: ArchUnit `layeredArchitecture()` / `slices().should().beFreeOfCycles()`, NetArchTest, `dependency-cruiser` `no-circular`, or `import-linter` layers contract.
step.output: `dependency_graph` block and one structural function entry with its verbatim command.
step.decision-gate: If the module graph already has cycles, the structural function starts in ratchet mode at the current violation count (r-ff-structural-dependency-function, r-ff-threshold-with-baseline-ratchet).

step.name: pick-tool-and-command
step.input: Candidate list from step 1; the CI runner and the languages in the repo.
step.action: For each characteristic choose the tool that measures it and write the exact command into `command` (`lizard -C 10 -w src/`, `k6 run perf/checkout.js`, `npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js src`). Where no tool measures it, set `mode: manual` and a `review_cadence`.
step.output: Every function has `tool` and either `command` or `review_cadence`.
step.decision-gate: If manual entries exceed one fifth of the suite, automate or delete until they do not (r-ff-executable-in-ci).

step.name: measure-baselines
step.input: The commands from step 3 run once against the current main branch.
step.action: Record the measured value and date as `baseline.value` / `baseline.measured_at` for every function.

step.name: set-thresholds
step.input: Baselines from step 4; the target values the architecture requires.
step.action: Write `threshold.operator` / `threshold.value`. Where the baseline already satisfies the threshold set `threshold_mode: absolute`; where it does not, set `threshold_mode: ratchet` (fail only when worse than baseline) and state `absolute_from` — the date or condition on which the absolute limit takes over.
step.decision-gate: An absolute threshold the baseline fails today is rejected: it would be red on its first run and disabled within a week (r-ff-threshold-with-baseline-ratchet, fm-threshold-fails-today).

step.name: classify-and-wire-ci
step.input: Runtime of each command measured in step 4; the pull-request pipeline definition.
step.action: Set `scope` (atomic | holistic), `trigger` (triggered | continual) and `consequence` (blocking | informational). Wire atomic blocking functions into the pull-request job; wire holistic functions (k6, chaos, full dependency scans) into a scheduled or post-merge job.
step.output: CI configuration with every function running; spec entries classified.
step.decision-gate: A holistic function marked `triggered` is rejected (r-ff-blocking-vs-informational, fm-holistic-in-pr-path).

step.name: wire-results-store
step.input: The CI job outputs; the metrics backend or a committed CSV location.
step.action: Emit each run's measured value keyed by function id and commit to `results_store.location`; set `retention_days` to at least the review horizon (90 for quarterly, 30 for monthly).
step.output: `results_store` block; a time series with at least one point per function.
step.decision-gate: A pipeline that records only pass/fail is not done (r-ff-results-trended).

step.name: assign-owners-and-review
step.action: Set `owner` (`role:handle`) on the suite and on every function; set `review.cadence`, `last_reviewed_at`, `next_review_at`. Fill the spec into `templates/skeleton.md.j2`, validate the JSON with `scripts/validate-evolutionary-architecture-fitness-functions.py`, commit. At each review read the trend per function; any function red or disabled for two consecutive reviews gets `action: fix | rebaseline | delete`.
step.output: Committed suite spec; review entry on the owner's calendar.
step.decision-gate: Promoting a function to blocking or lowering a threshold is approved by the named owner before it lands in CI (03 human checkpoint).

list.item: Spec validates against the schema in `content/02-output-contract.xml` and the validator reports no cross-field violation.
Every function has run at least once in CI and its value appears in the results series.
The structural function is green or in ratchet mode with a stated `absolute_from`.
